card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 Pro That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 14 Pro That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max SMC panic Sensor Array values: 0x80000 (524288) = proximity flex; 0x40000 (262144) = charging port flex; 0x100000 (1048576) = power button flex.
claims.evidence: Code mapping on the source page.

claims.statement: Combined values add up: 0xc0000 = prox + charge port; 0x180000 = prox + power button; 0x140000 = power button + charge port; 0x1c0000 = all three.
0x20000 (131072) = sandwich separation: gyro U7300 not detected; check its pads 542, 543, 544, 545, 546, 6 and 248; needs sandwich reball or bottom board swap. 0xa0000 = sandwich + prox flex.
0x41 (65) = battery data issue (fluctuating % or non-genuine message): check connector pins, compare diode readings, known-good battery, replace connector.

procedure: Read the Sensor Array value from the SMC panic in panic-full.
Decode bits: prox 0x80000, charge port 0x40000, power button 0x100000, gyro/sandwich 0x20000.
Test with known-good OEM flexes for each flagged part; diode-check their FPCs.
For 0x20000 inspect gyro U7300 pads and reball the sandwich.
For 0x41 work the battery data path.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
card.component: Prox / charge port / power button flex / sandwich
